title: "Homework 13"

```{r}
# Question 1

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(lme4)

starwars

# My question is is there a relationship between height and mass

star_gamma <- lmer(
  height ~  sex * mass + (1 | skin_color),
  data = starwars)
anovagamma <- Anova(star_gamma)
anovagamma
# This analysis included a non-Gaussian mixed model with random effects

starplot1 <- ggplot(data = starwars) +
  aes(x = factor(skin_color), y = mass) +
  geom_boxplot()

starplot1
```
